questions.q: Which three elements does DeMarco define as true wealth?
questions.why: He lists meaningful relationships, health, and freedom as wealth.

questions.q: What does DeMarco say money can buy most effectively?
questions.why: The text states money can buy unlimited amounts of freedom.

questions.q: How did J.K. Rowling achieve income independent of time?
questions.why: Royalties continued after the book was finished, freeing time.

questions.q: What habit does DeMarco recommend to shift from consumer to producer?
questions.why: He urges to stop consuming and switch into producer mode.

questions.q: What is the core idea behind making income independent of time?
questions.why: He says you must unlink income from the hours you put into work.
